full_judgment: iii) In line with the general holiday declared by the Government with a view to preventing spread of Coronavirus, the Hon'ble Chief Justice by order dated 04 April declared holiday for the Courts. This was extended from time to time until 30th May in line with the general holiday declared by the Government. However, the Courts under the jurisdiction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate and Chief Metropolitan Magistrate were kept open for urgent matters and the limitation period of the orders passed were extended which would have otherwise expired.
